verdict: ChatGPT: Choose ChatGPT when a general-purpose LLM assistant with custom projects, connectors, and a clear team upgrade path is the primary job. Scores use the AI editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Category-leading LLM assistant breadth and brand recognition
Free tier plus clear Plus/Business/Pro ladder
Custom GPT projects and strong connector ecosystem
Strong reasoning and multimodal output on paid tiers
Enterprise path for admin and governance
weaknesses: Not a specialist writing, voice, or ad tool
Governance depth requires paid team tiers
bestFor: Teams and individuals wanting a mainstream general-purpose LLM assistant
Buyers who need custom GPT projects and broad model access on Plus/Pro
Orgs standardizing on OpenAI with Business admin and connector depth
notIdealFor: Buyers whose primary job is paraphrasing/grammar only (QuillBot)
tradeoffs: Published free tiers vs paid usage/credit caps
Bundled Workspace/One plans vs standalone assistant pricing
Credit/overage models vs predictable seat pricing
Enterprise admin controls vs individual consumer plans
recommendation: Choose ChatGPT when a general-purpose LLM assistant with custom projects, connectors, and a clear team upgrade path is the primary job. Compare Claude for long-context writing and reasoning style, Gemini for Google Workspace integration, and QuillBot if you only need paraphrasing — not a full LLM.
editorialNotes: AI Wave-1 batch. Approved on ai-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=llm-assistant. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: ChatGPT is the mainstream LLM assistant with approachable chat UX and custom GPT projects — low friction for non-technical users. Score from first-party packaging, not hands-on lab testing.
Primary job is general-purpose LLM assistant — chat, reasoning, coding, and custom projects match the llm-assistant cluster strongly. Scored inside LLM peers, not against QuillBot or ElevenLabs.
OpenAI's flagship models and reasoning modes are category-leading for breadth — strong output across writing, code, and multimodal tasks within the LLM cluster.
Custom GPTs, memory, file uploads, and team workspaces add workflow depth beyond bare chat — held at 8 vs deepest agent-builder platforms.
Native connectors for Slack, Teams, Google Workspace plus Zapier-style automation — top-tier ecosystem for an LLM assistant.
Business and Enterprise publish admin controls and data policies; deepest governance is sales-gated. Strong for mid-market teams at Business tier.
Clear Free → Plus → Business → Pro → Enterprise ladder supports individual through enterprise scale; 2-seat Business minimum is the main micro-team friction.
Free tier and $20 Plus are competitive entry points; Business 2-seat minimum and Pro pricing raise TCO for small teams. Capability justifies spend at scale. Affiliate economics excluded.
Flagship OpenAI models, reasoning modes, and image generation on paid tiers — among the strongest model capability in the LLM cluster.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine AI editorial criteria using category weights (AI job fit 16, output quality 14, ease of use 12, workflow depth 12, integrations 10, governance/privacy 10, value 10, model capability 8, scalability 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — LLM assistants, writing, voice, presentations, websites, ad creative, and agent builders are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
